hook: OpenRouter drops three providers after data leak findings.

beats.say: Security researchers found some inference providers had data compromised or weren't honoring their data policies. OpenRouter says it was not breached itself.
It off-boarded three providers and removed 125 endpoints from Zero Data Retention eligibility, then notified potentially affected customers.
Next, it plans to run the researchers' tests continuously and verify network paths to catch requests forwarded to third parties.
